phrasings.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')

# Group by month and region, calculate revenue and orders
grouped_df = df.groupby(['month', 'region']).agg({'revenue': 'sum', 'orders': 'count'})

# Plot the grouped data
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
for month, region in grouped_df.index:
    revenue = grouped_df.loc[(month, region), 'revenue']
    orders = grouped_df.loc[(month, region), 'orders']
    plt.plot([month], [revenue], marker='o', label=f'{region} - Revenue')
    plt.plot([month], [orders], marker='o', label=f'{region} - Orders')

plt.xlabel('Month')
plt.ylabel('Revenue (in thousands)')
plt.title('Monthly Sales Summary')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')

# Group by '年月' and calculate '患者数' and '平均待ち時間'
grouped_df = df.groupby('年月')['患者数', '平均待ち時間'].sum()

# Plotting the data
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

# Bar chart for '患者数'
plt.bar(grouped_df.index, grouped_df['患者数'], color='skyblue')

# Line chart for '平均待ち時間'
plt.plot(grouped_df.index, grouped_df['平均待ち時間'], color='orange')

# Adding labels and title
plt.xlabel('年月')
plt.ylabel('患者数/平均待ち時間')
plt.title('患者数と平均待ち時間の比較')

# Adding a legend
plt.legend()

# Show the plot
plt.show()
